description: Source code for handling archive operations such as listing and extracting files in the 'ar' archive format, including parsing output and managing archive entries.

methods.name: xa_ar_ask
methods.description: Sets the archive's ability to extract and touch files.

methods.name: xa_ar_parse_output
methods.description: Parses a line of output from the archive listing command to extract file information.

methods.name: xa_ar_list
methods.description: Lists the contents of an archive by executing the 'tv' command and parsing its output.

methods.name: xa_ar_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from the archive by executing the 'x' command.
